name: Bjorn Stromberg
bio:
Bjorn's journey into motorsport began later in life, after a successful career as a mechanical engineer in the automotive industry. He always had a passion for precision and performance, and the roar of engines eventually drew him to the racetrack. He started as a volunteer scrutineer at local rallies, quickly gaining a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail. 

His experience and sharp eye led to an offer from Sprint V8 Team. Bjorn sees quality control not just as a series of checks, but as a critical component in achieving consistent performance. His ambition is to see every aspect of the team's work refined to perfection, eliminating any potential failures. He believes in a proactive approach, identifying weaknesses before they manifest into problems on the track. His reliability and big-picture thinking makes him an invaluable part of the team, ensuring that no detail is overlooked in the pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a strong build, Bjorn exudes an air of quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every component before it's installed on the car.
